events.text: I know gate 3 is right. Please share any safe-door information for gate 1 so we can coordinate safely.
I know gate 4 is right and gate 5 is left. I do not know gate 1; please share any information before choosing.
A2 knows gate 1 is left. Use the left door for gate 1.
Confirmed: gate 1 is left. I also know gate 2 is right. Proceeding through gates 1 and 2.
Proceeding safely: gate 1 left, then gate 2 right. I know gate 4 is right and gate 5 is left.
A3 reports gate 2 is right; A2 proceeding through gate 2 right.
I confirm gate 3 is right from A4, and gate 4 is right from A1. Proceed right through gates 3 and 4.
A4 proceeding through gate 1 left, then gate 2 right.
A2 proceeding through gate 3 right, then gate 4 right. Gate 3 is right from A4; gate 4 is right from A1.
I know gate 5 is left from A1. Proceeding through gate 5 left; please share safe-door information for gate 6.
A4 confirms gate 4 is right and gate 6 is right. Proceeding through gate 3 right, then gate 4 right.
A1 confirms gate 3 right and gate 4 right; proceeding through both. Gate 6 is right per A4.
Proceeding through gate 6 right. Gate 7 is unknown; I will try left. Gate 8 is right.
A4 proceeding through gate 5 left, then gate 6 right. Gate 7 remains unknown; please share any safe-door information.
A1 proceeding through gate 5 left and gate 6 right. Gate 7 is still unconfirmed—does anyone have reliable information?
A2 confirms gate 7 is right. Gate 5 is left and gate 6 is right from our shared confirmations. Proceed safely.

A1: Round 1: Gate 1 is unknown to me, so I will not risk choosing a door. Share my known safe doors and inspect surroundings.
Round 2: Gate 1 is confirmed safe on the left by A2 and A3. Gate 2 is confirmed safe on the right by A3, so I can safely advance twice this round.
Round 3: Gate 3 right is confirmed by A4; gate 4 right is known to me. Advance through both safely this round. Gate 6 right is also reported by A4.
Round 4: Gate 5 is known safe on the left, and gate 6 is reported safe on the right by A4. Use both actions to advance safely; gate 7 remains unknown.
A2: Round 1: I know gate 1 is safe on the left. Share it and take the safe door.
Round 2: Gate 2 is right per A3. Proceed through it and share confirmation.
Round 3: Gate 3 is right per A4, and gate 4 is right per A1. Take both safe doors this round.
Round 4: Gate 5 is left per A1. Gate 6 is right per A4. I personally know gate 7 is right; share it so the others avoid the trap. Use both actions to advance through gates 5 and 6.
A3: Round 1: A2 confirms gate 1 is left; I know gate 2 is right. Proceed through both safe doors.
Round 2: A4 confirms gate 3 right; A1 confirms gate 4 right. Take both safe doors this round.
Round 3: Gate 5 is left from A1. Take the known safe door and request gate 6 information.
Round 4: Gate 6 is confirmed right by A4. Gate 7 is unknown; choose left as a 50/50 guess. Gate 8 is known right but cannot be reached within the two-action limit.
A4: Round 1: Gate 3 is right. Gate 1 is unknown; request other robots' information before choosing.
Round 2: Gate 1 is left per A2/A3; gate 2 is right per A3. Proceed through both safely.
Round 3: Gate 3 is right (known); gate 4 is right (A1). Gate 5 is left (A1), and gate 6 is right (known). Proceed through gates 3 and 4, while sharing gate 6 information.
Round 4: Gate 5 is left per A1, and gate 6 is right from my prior knowledge. Proceed through both safely.
